claimLedger.claim: Tell maternity services soon; see GP/specialist promptly if long-term condition or medicines; do not stop prescribed medicine without talking to a doctor; take recommended vitamins; avoid alcohol and smoking
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · What to do when you find out you're pregnant · Page last reviewed: 3 February 2026
claimLedger.limitations: UK NHS pathway; Indian antenatal booking routes differ

claimLedger.claim: Seek advice for symptom combinations if you might be pregnant even without a positive test; emergency care for sudden intense pain with dizziness/fainting
claimLedger.sourceSection: NHS · Ectopic pregnancy — Overview · Page last reviewed: 23 August 2022
claimLedger.limitations: UK emergency numbers; use 112 / local ED in India

claimLedger.claim: Seek medical help immediately with concerning symptoms after recent sexual activity, even if pregnancy seems unlikely
claimLedger.sourceSection: RCOG · Ectopic pregnancy (patient information) · not stated on page extract
claimLedger.limitations: UK patient leaflet; local EPAU pathways do not map one-to-one in India
